newsitem.title: UK: Powerscreen says Q1 trading ahead.
newsitem.headline: Powerscreen says Q1 trading ahead.

text.p: British recycling and materials handling equipment maker Powerscreen International Plc said on Monday that trading in the first quarter of its financial year was ahead of the year-earlier period.

"The year ended March 31 was the most successful year to date, both in sales and profits. I am pleased to report that the trend is continuing in the current year, despite the adverse exchange rate movements in the period," chairman John Craig said in a statement to the annual meeting.
Craig said Powerscreen's screening division had had a strong first quarter, reflecting strong demand in north America and the recycling industries.
Craig said Powerscreen would continue to seek acquisitions in the engineering industry.
